ruleset.name: dead-code
ruleset.description:
Dead-code detection, restricted to the members that are provably safe to delete.
This ruleset deliberately covers PRIVATE members only. A broader "unused" analysis cannot be made sound for this codebase: Spring invokes @Scheduled, @PostConstruct and @EventListener methods reflectively, REST controllers are reached only through the servlet mapping, and Jackson and Lombok call accessors by name. None of those have Java callers, so any tool that treated caller-count as proof of dead code would delete the trading schedulers and the controllers along with the genuinely dead code.
checkAll stays false on UnusedFormalParameter for the same reason: interface and override implementations must keep their parameters regardless of whether the body reads them.
